Who We Are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

SUMMARY: The Business Analyst (BA) will work with other stakeholders within the organization to deliver the solutions by translating business needs into clear, actionable, and testable requirements that support predictable, high‑quality delivery.

BAs will function as a liaison between business and technology by ensuring problems are well understood, solutions are feasible, and delivered outcomes meet intended business objectives.

Responsibilities

Tasks may include but are not limited to:

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

• Work closely with Product Managers (PdMs) and technology teams to evaluate processes, identify areas for improvement, constraints and provide solution clarity and feasibility. 
• Participate in stakeholder workshops with PdMs to identify needs and work with PdMs to analyse current vs. future-state processes, produce product/solution wireframes, process flows, data flows and capture user stories. 
• Translate epics and features from PdM into detailed business requirements. The BA will elicit business requirements, analyse data, and create requirements that align with a product’s vision and strategy. Identify dependencies, constraints, and edge cases. 
• Perform impact analysis of proposed solution on existing systems and make recommendations to minimize impact, complexity or cost of solution. 
• Interpret data and their trends to identify business opportunities, enhance system performance and make recommendations to the business (add to product backlog) 
• Work with PdMs and business stakeholders to identify cost and value points for assigned solutions/capabilities. 
• BAs will function as a liaison between business and technology group to provide clarification and support in order to assure business requirements are feasible and implemented correctly. 
• Clearly define acceptance criteria, assist development teams with requirements traceability and support user acceptance testing (UAT). Ensure solutions meet defined business needs 
• Product areas may include and are not limited to SaaS products and/or related 3rd party solutions, system integrations, dashboards and reports. 

Other Skills And Abilities

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
• Working knowledge of software development lifecycles (SDLC), especially agile methodology. 
• Preferred Qualifications 
• Familiarity with clinical trials, patient safety, data integrity and associated regulations desired. 
• Familiarity with GxP or other regulated environments (eg trading systems). 
• Familiarity with risk assessment and mitigation planning strategies 
• Understanding of SaaS application and integration architectures and how they can and should be utilized to achieve business goals 
• Familiarity with user experience concepts and best practices 
• Familiarity with modelling tools (e.g. MS Visio, PowerPoint), UX tools (Balsamiq, Figma) and data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio), and portfolio and requirements management tools (JIRA, DevOps, OnePlan). 

Requirements

• BSc degree in Business, Business Analysis, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field. 
• 5+ years in a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst role. Experience maybe considered in lew of a degree. 
• Proven experience in business analysis, translating business needs into functional and non-functional requirements. 
• Proven experience analysing processes, complex data sets, business workflows and translating epics and features into detailed business requirements. Experience with identifying dependencies, constraints, and edge cases, creating use cases and user stories. 
• Experience in producing product/solution wireframes, process flows, data flows and aligning them with different user personas and functional areas. 
• Preferred Qualifications 
• Experience in working with multidisciplinary teams to meet strategic objectives, influence decisions and provide conflict resolution. 
• 5+ years experience working with clinical trial systems/applications and understanding of the computer systems utilized in support of clinical trials. 

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law.

Role:
As one of the founding members of Kanerika's Databricks delivery practice, you will be a hands-on builder responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines on Databricks for client engagements. You'll work closely with the Practice Lead to translate architecture into working solutions, build reusable accelerators ahead of client demand, and help establish engineering best practices for the growing team.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT data pipelines on Databricks using PySpark and Spark SQL.
• Build and maintain incremental ingestion pipelines using Auto Loader and structured streaming, including checkpoint management and schema evolution handling.
• Implement and maintain Delta Lake tables (including Change Data Feed and liquid clustering), Unity Catalog structures, and Databricks Workflows for client and internal projects.
• Build reusable accelerators, templates, and demo environments to support pre-sales and speed up future client delivery.
• Collaborate with the Practice Lead/Architect on solution design for client engagements, providing engineering-level input on feasibility and effort.
• Perform data quality checks, performance tuning, and cost optimization on Databricks clusters and jobs.
• Participate in client-facing technical discussions as needed, including discovery sessions and technical walkthroughs.
• Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following team engineering standards.
• Mentor junior engineers as the team scales, and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing and best-practice documentation.
• Troubleshoot and resolve production data pipeline issues across client environments.
• Stay current with Databricks platform releases across Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, and share learnings with the team through internal knowledge sessions and documentation.
 
Required Skills & Experience
• 5–9 years of data engineering experience, with at least 2 years of hands-on Databricks experience in production.
• Strong proficiency in PySpark and/or Spark SQL for large-scale data processing.
• Practical experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows/job orchestration.
• Solid SQL skills and experience with data modeling for analytics/lakehouse architectures.
• Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP); Azure strongly preferred.
• Experience with Python for data engineering tasks beyond Spark (scripting, automation, testing).
• Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines (Git-based workflows, automated testing/deployment).
• Strong debugging and performance-tuning skills for Spark jobs (partitioning, caching, cluster sizing).
• Good communication skills and comfort working directly with client stakeholders when needed.

PEFERRED/ NICE TO HAVE
• Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional certification.
• Experience with Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables), Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion, MLflow for experiment tracking and model registry, Databricks SQL, and AI/BI Genie.
• Exposure to data governance and security frameworks (row/column-level security, data masking).
• Prior experience in a consulting/IT services environment delivering to multiple clients.
• Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow) and ingestion tools (Fivetran, Kafka, Azure Data Factory).
What Success Looks Like
• Within 3 months: Comfortable with Kanerika's delivery standards; has built or contributed to at least one reusable accelerator/demo asset.
• Within 6 months: Independently delivering core engineering work on client engagement(s) with minimal oversight.
• Within 12 months: Recognized as a go-to senior engineer on the team, mentoring newer hires and contributing to architecture decisions.
• Leading databricks partnership upgrade to Gold level.

QUICK FACTS 
 Position - Lead Research Analyst — Institutional Equities
Location - Mumbai (BKC Office)
Experience - 7-15 years in equity research with strong coverage of Indian companies across BFSI, Healthcare, and IT
Qualification - Postgraduate in Finance, CA, MBA, or CFA (USA) — will be a strong advantage
Reports To- Head of Research / CEO
Compensation - Competitive , commensurate with experience. ESOPs for exceptional performers.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Research is not a support function at Monarch. It is the backbone of everything we do.
This is not a role where you write reports that sit in inboxes. This is a role where your research moves capital, drives investment decisions, and directly impacts the portfolios of institutional investors, HNIs, and our own AIF and PMS clients. Your conviction becomes our conviction. 

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a Lead Research Analyst to manage end-to-end equity research coverage for our Institutional Equities division, with primary focus on BFSI, Healthcare, and IT sectors. You will generate differentiated, high-conviction research that drives investment decisions for our institutional buy-side clients — mutual funds, insurance companies, FPIs, family offices , while simultaneously informing the investment strategies of our AIF, PMS, and HNI advisory businesses.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Research & Analysis
▸ Financial Modelling: Develop, maintain, and enhance detailed financial models — earnings forecasts, revenue builds, segment-level projections, balance sheet modelling, and DCF/SOTP/relative valuations using appropriate methodologies.
▸ Research Reports: Produce high-quality initiating coverage reports, thematic pieces, sectoral deep-dives, quarterly earnings previews/reviews, and timely stock-specific update notes that generate client engagement and trading ideas.
▸ Differentiated Insights: Go beyond consensus. Conduct channel checks, supply chain analysis, management interactions, plant visits, and primary data analysis to develop proprietary insights that give our clients an information edge.
▸ Conviction Calls: Develop and maintain a track record of high-conviction BUY and SELL recommendations with clear catalysts, target prices, and risk-reward frameworks. Your best ideas should be bold enough to move capital.
Client Engagement
▸ Institutional Relationships: Engage directly with institutional buy-side clients — mutual funds, insurance companies, pension funds, FPIs, and family offices — to present research views, discuss investment ideas, and build long-term advisory relationships.
▸ Corporate Access: Facilitate and lead corporate access initiatives — management meetings, investor conferences, non-deal roadshows, plant/site visits, and sector roundtables — that deepen client engagement and strengthen Monarch's institutional franchise.
▸ Client Feedback & Rankings: Drive research output quality that earns client recognition, positive feedback, and rankings in institutional surveys such as Asiamoney, II, and other industry polls.
Team & Culture
▸ Ownership: Take full ownership of your sector coverage. You are not writing reports for approval — you are building a franchise within a franchise. Your sector is your business.
▸ Mentorship: Guide and develop junior analysts. Build a culture of intellectual rigour, original thinking, and accountability within the research team.
